mapper.update: UPDATE survey_schedule SET sched_date = #{date} WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM survey_schedule WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.schedule_id, DATE_FORMAT(s.sched_date, '%Y-%m-%d') sched_date, s.survey_id, l.title , p.plan_id, p.factor_id, f.bld_id, p.visit_order , b.addr, b.bld_nm, b.use_nm, b.sgg_cd, CAST(f.vulnerability_score AS SIGNED) score , r.record_id, DATE_FORMAT(v.visited_at, '%H:%i') visit_time, v.result, d.supports , (SELECT v2.result FROM visit_history v2 WHERE v2.bld_id = f.bld_id AND v2.visited_at < s.sched_date ORDER BY v2.visited_at DESC, v2.visit_id DESC LIMIT 1) prev_result FROM survey_schedule s JOIN survey_list l ON l.survey_id = s.survey_id JOIN survey_plan p ON p.survey_id = s.survey_id JOIN vulnerability_factor f ON f.factor_id = p.factor_id JOIN building b ON b.bld_id = f.bld_id LEFT JOIN survey_record r ON r.record_id = ( SELECT r1.record_id FROM survey_record r1 JOIN visit_history v1 ON v1.visit_id = r1.visit_id WHERE r1.plan_id = p.plan_id AND DATE(v1.visited_at) = s.sched_date ORDER BY v1.visited_at DESC, r1.record_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN visit_history v ON v.visit_id = r.visit_id LEFT JOIN survey_record_detail d ON d.record_id = r.record_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.sched_date >= #{start} AND s.sched_date < #{end} ORDER BY s.sched_date, l.title, p.visit_order IS NULL, p.visit_order, p.plan_id
